answer: An agent may mint working identity weight only after collecting a short-lived signed cipher from several established, unaffiliated counterparties. Each cipher expires in a few epochs and grants a small increment. Honest use sends a decaying trust ripple two hops out, but that ripple fades before a clique can amplify itself. Sponsors lock stake in a public shale of stratified bonds that burns if the newcomer is slashed as a sybil. An attacker must buy a fresh outsider cipher for every clone and risk those shale deposits, so the cost grows with headcount and cannot stay inside a puppet ring.
